question: How do elemental principles arise from modes of the will-power?
premises: The will-power can reach the state of supreme bliss.
Its swiftness, illumination, and firmness are distinct modes.
These modes are named as air, fire, and earth.
inference: Elemental principles are expressions of modal qualities within the same will-power.
uncertainties: The verse compresses several identifications into a single compound chain.
plain_english: The will-power itself, having reached supreme bliss, is called air through swiftness, fire through shining, and earth through firmness.
